recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片裡可見數顆大型雙核細胞，兩個核成對排列、各有一個清楚的藍色大核仁，細胞質淡而豐富，周圍混有淋巴球、漿細胞與顆粒球，符合 Reed-Sternberg 細胞。
features: Several large binucleate cells, 3-4 times the size of small lymphocytes
Paired, mirror-image oval nuclei each containing a single prominent blue nucleolus
Vesicular to finely granular chromatin with smooth nuclear contours
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Mixed inflammatory background: small lymphocytes, plasma cells, segmented neutrophils and granulocytic precursors
describe_en: Wright-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large binucleate cells with paired mirror-image nuclei, each containing a single conspicuous nucleolus, and abundant pale cytoplasm. These cells are present in a polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and maturing granulocytes. There are no cohesive clusters to suggest carcinoma. Findings are consistent with Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma involving the bone marrow, to be confirmed on trephine biopsy with CD30/CD15 positivity and weak PAX5 expression.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have one lobulated nucleus without large inclusion-like nucleoli and have granular cytoplasm, a frequent aspirate pitfall.
Osteoclasts contain many (often >5) small uniform nuclei with small nucleoli in abundant granular cytoplasm rather than two large nuclei with macronucleoli.

ddx.dx: Immunoblasts in reactive or viral states (e.g., EBV)
ddx.vs: Immunoblasts can be binucleate but are smaller with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and are CD45+/CD20+ or CD3+, lacking the CD15+/CD45- RS phenotype.
ALCL cells occur in cohesive sheets with horseshoe nuclei and are ALK+ or EMA+ with T-cell markers, rather than scattered cells in a mixed background.
